name: Menubar
label: Menu bar
description: A persistent row of menus, like an app's File, Edit and View, with arrow keys along the bar.

props.name: menus
props.description: The menus, in order along the bar.

props.name: keyLabels
props.description: Key names for the shortcut hints in every menu, for a keyboard other than English (passed to each DropdownMenu).

MenubarMenu.description: One menu in the bar: its trigger's label and the entries it opens.

ShortcutKeyLabels.description: The legends a shortcut is drawn with, by modifier or key name. Merged over the platform's defaults.

rows.text: Moves focus into the bar at the last menu it was on, and out of the bar on the next press.
Moves to the next menu, opening it if a menu is open.
Moves to the previous menu, opening it if a menu is open.
Opens the menu and moves into it; the menu's own keys then apply.
Closes the open menu and returns focus to its name in the bar.

alternatives.name: Toolbar
alternatives.when: the bar holds controls that act at once rather than menus

alternatives.name: DropdownMenu
alternatives.when: one menu opens from one trigger
